title: 新一代三维编织智能控制与数字孪生系统通过阶段性评审
titleEn: Next-generation 3D Braiding Intelligent Control and Digital Twin System Passes Phase Review
summary: 经过多名复材界知名院士及技术评审专家的闭门审查，云路复材自主开发的第3代数字孪生控制器通过评审。该系统首度实现了纱线轨迹受力实时反向计算，将纤维损伤率降低至0.05%以下。
summaryEn: After closed-door review by renowned composite material academicians and technical experts, Yunlu Composites' independently developed 3rd-generation digital twin controller passed evaluation. The system achieved real-time reverse calculation of yarn trajectory forces for the first time, reducing fiber damage rate to below 0.05%.
content:
经过多名复材界知名院士及技术评审专家的闭门审查，云路复材自主开发的第3代数字孪生控制器通过评审。该系统首度实现了纱线轨迹受力实时反向计算，将纤维损伤率降低至0.05%以下。

在传统的编织过程中，纱线与导轨摩擦、相互交织时极易产生机械磨损，导致强度下降。全新研发的数字孪生系统利用物理引擎和有限元计算，可以实时演算每一根纱线的精确位置和极限抗拉强度，提前 100ms 预测摩擦过载并做出张力补偿微调。专家组一致评价该控制算法在特种异形中空件织造质量控制方面达到了国内领先、国际先进水平，推荐尽快投入大规模工业量产使用。
contentEn:
After closed-door review by renowned composite material academicians and technical experts, Yunlu Composites' independently developed 3rd-generation digital twin controller passed evaluation. The system achieved real-time reverse calculation of yarn trajectory forces for the first time, reducing fiber damage rate to below 0.05%.

In traditional braiding processes, yarn-rail friction and interweaving easily cause mechanical wear, leading to strength degradation. The newly developed digital twin system uses physics engines and finite element calculations to compute the precise position and ultimate tensile strength of each yarn in real-time, predicting friction overload 100ms in advance and making tension compensation adjustments. The expert panel unanimously evaluated that the control algorithm has reached domestic leading and internationally advanced levels in quality control for specialty irregular hollow component braiding, recommending immediate deployment for large-scale industrial production.
